title: Cheating / Infidelity
summary: Cheating is breaking a relationship's agreed exclusivity rules — physically or emotionally. Couples respond differently: some separate, others rebuild trust with time, honesty and sometimes counselling.
answer_guidance: Be empathetic and non-judgemental; don't tell the user what they must do.
